description: US Drought Monitor county statistics for one US county (5-digit FIPS) and one weekly map date: percent of the county's area in no drought and in drought categories D0 (abnormally dry) to D4 (exceptional), from the USDM public API. County level only; crop-specific indices are not included. Related tools on this server, for a different need: energy_us_electric_grid_monitor when you need US electric grid monitor from EIA's Hourly Electric Grid. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

date.description: USDM map date YYYY-MM-DD (a Tuesday); default: the most recent Tuesday

fips.description: 5-digit US county FIPS code, e.g. 48201 (Harris County, TX)

name: energy_drought_monitor_us_crop
title: US Drought Monitor county statistics for one US county
